import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def max_fruits_sliced(n, fruits):
    events = []
    
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(fruits):
        # Calculate the slope of the line passing through the center of the circle and perpendicular to the x-axis
        slope = (y + 1) / (x + 1e-9)  # Avoid division by zero
        # Calculate the intercept of the line
        intercept = y - slope * x
        # Create events for the start and end of the interval
        events.append((intercept - slope, 1))  # Start of the interval
        events.append((intercept + slope, -1))  # End of the interval
    
    # Sort events by intercept, and by type (start before end if same intercept)
    events.sort()
    
    max_overlap = 0
    current_overlap = 0
